description: LiNaV₂O₆ is Esseneite structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.63 Å. Li is bonded to six O atoms to form LiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.28 Å. V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent LiO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-61°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.83 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Li, and one V atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaLi₂V tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent V atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Li, and one V atom.
